args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Problem
`tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212, but `src/money.py`'s `round_money` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, causing the nightly build to fail.

## Fix
Changed `round_money` to quantize with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed (including `test_half_even`, e.g. `2.665 -> 2.66`).

Fix: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN. 2.675 → 2.68? With ROUND_HALF_EVEN: 2.675 quantize to 0.01 → 2.68 (since 7 is odd, rounds to 8? half even means round to even last digit: 2.67 vs 2.68 → 8 is even → 2.68). Yes. 2.665 → 2.66 (6 even). Good.

Also might remove unused import.
